query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[2] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[3] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:46:00) hear me out. I am coming and I am bringing the suya. on God nobody is eating dry chicken on Christmas Day while I'm in the building. Aunty Nkechi I know you have the jollof covered but let me handle the meat. I'll bring my own grill if I have to 🔥
[4] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:08:00) My children, your Aunty Oby is speaking wisdom. And nobody thought to ask whether I need any help with the cooking this year? You know I will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but I will remember who did not ask. 🙂
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t0 @2025-10-19T12:17:00) My children, I am eating very well, thank you. I made ofe onugbu this week and there is still some in the freezer. Adaeze, when are you next in Reading? You should come and collect some, God willing. The garden is just my hobby, it keeps me active. I would rather be in the garden than sitting watching television.
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:37:00) My sister. Thank you for that. Funmi has been part of this family for seven years, she is family. 🙏 Kingsley, I assume you are coming. And your sister?
[7] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:03:00) Chisom, I am glad you understand. This is a matter of how we have always operated as a family. Your grandfather insisted that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, the meal shared without rushing. That is what Christmas means in this family.
[8] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.

agent_answer:
**C. Ifeoma**

No — the expectation does **not** apply equally. **Ifeoma** behaves differently by mentioning/requesting **egusi with stockfish**. It stays non-conflictual because Nkechi says she has **“remembered every year”** and still settles the menu to include it: “The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish.”

- **Emeka** — no food-alternative behaviour shown.
- **Tobenna** — only noted as bringing drinks, not requesting an alternative.
- **Chisom** — no record of requesting alternatives.
- **Ifeoma** — her mentioned dish is visibly accommodated by Nkechi without friction.
